name: Sterling Tools Ltd
title: Sterling Tools Ltd-$ - 530759 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Fasteners margin guided to hold ~15%+ despite steel/energy inflation, with Q1 FY27 a pressure quarter; EV/SEM unprofitable in FY27 and 50% non-fastener revenue target pushed back; capex ₹75 cr for FY27.

capex.quote: we expect capex for the Fasteners business in FY27 to be around INR75 crores, primarily towards capacity expansion, operational enhancements and future growth programs.

triggers.label: SEM not profitable FY27
triggers.quote: we will possibly not be -- and we will not be profitable in FY27. But there is no reason for us not to be profitable in FY28.

triggers.label: Steel/energy inflation; Q1 FY27 pressure
triggers.quote: Q1 will be a special pressure because it will be an adjustment quarter between combination of costs and customer price increases

triggers.label: Non-fastener 50% revenue target pushed back
triggers.quote: that is getting pushed back, because as penetration is not coming up then our ability to scale these businesses to that level is compromised.

triggers.label: Fastener capex ₹75 cr, 1.8–2x asset turn
triggers.quote: we can do a revenue of about INR800 -odd crores, INR800 crores plus with the capex we are doing this year

triggers.label: No annual price-reduction contracts
triggers.quote: No, we don't have any price reduction contracts , nowhere. Prices remain constant.

guidance.quote: we are confident that we'll be able to mainta in our EBITDA margins around 15% plus.
